tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background for buyer storefront and all consoles.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies, inputs, modals.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table headers, image placeholders, side navigation ground.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Footer, toast and tooltip grounds. Text on it is ink-inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (both themes, 12:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table meta on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (5.2:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders. 3:1 on surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Convie Green. Primary actions, links, selected states, paid/settled status text. Text-safe on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for brand buttons.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (6.5:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, success pill ground, available-balance tile. Text on it is brand or ink.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Saffron. Promotional fills, FX-lock banner, new-vendor flags. Fill only, never text; text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (9:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Pending-balance tile, rate-locked notice ground. Text on it is ink or warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed payments, disputes, reconciliation breaks. Always paired with a word or icon (lightness close to brand).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error alert and failed-pill ground. Text on it is danger or ink.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, on-hold, awaiting-review text and icons.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning alert and pending-pill ground.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational notices, in-transit status, links inside ledger tables.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info alert and shipped-pill ground.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals and drawers.

styles.name: display-xl

styles.usage: Storefront hero only, one per page.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Page titles in consoles and buyer flows.

styles.name: heading-sm

styles.name: body-lg

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Funds move to available 7 days after delivery.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Ships from Accra in 2 to 4 days

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Balance and KPI tiles. Always tabular figures.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Prices on product cards, order totals.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Ledger IDs, gateway references, SKUs, request IDs.
